title: Cute East Nashville Pad
description:
* Over 450 5 Star Reviews!

* 3.5 Miles from Downtown Nashville (Predators and Titan's games, CMA Fest, Honky Tonks,  Ryman, Etc

* 1. 5 Miles from 5 points (the heart of "East Nashville")

* 7 Miles from The Grand Ol Opry and Opryland Mall

* Super cool music themed layout!

The space
Feel at home in this  2 bedroom with ikea kitchen and bathroom. Accommodates 2 couples comfortably, and be staying within minutes to the hip "5 Points" area of East Nashville, and also downtown (Titan's and Predator's games, CMA Fest, Honky Tonks, Broadway, The Ryman Auditorium, Country Music Hall Of Fame, Johnny Cash Museum and the new "Ascend Amphitheater"). The house is also only 7 miles (15 min drive) to The Grand Ol Opry and Opryland and Hotel and Opry Mills Mall.

Guest access
you'll have access to the entire house, including a washer and dryer in the basement (if needed), plus an additional airbed is available if you need more than two beds while you are staying - just ask!

Other things to note
Please do not park vehicles on the front lawn of the property. Parking is available at the rear of the house in the space marked "House Only", and there is parking available for 2 vehicles (on the "Right" in the parking area). There is an additional completley seperate Airbnb ("The Barn") in the backyard of the property and those guests strickly park to the "Left" of the property.
